<math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><mo><</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">G</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mo><</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mo><</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">T</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></math>

questions.solution:
The inert-pair effect is the tendency of the two electrons in the outermost atomic-s orbital to remain unshared in compounds of post-transition elements.

Inert-pair effect is seen in the elements of 13th,14th, 15th and 16th groups.

Due to the inert-pair effect elements down the group exhibit oxidation state which is 2 units lesser than the elements above them.

Stability of +1 oxidation state due to inert pair effect is in the order Al<Ga<In<Tl

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which one of the following statements is not correct?
options: Alcohols are weaker acids than water Acid strength of alcohols decreases in the following $\mathrm{RCH}_2 \mathrm{OH}\gt \mathrm{R}_2 \mathrm{CHOH}\gt \mathrm{R}_3 \mathrm{COH}$ Carbon-oxygen bond length in methanol, $\mathrm{CH}_3 \mathrm{OH}$ is shorter than that of $\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{O}$ bond length in phenol.
questions.solution: The $\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{O}$ bond length in alcohols is $142 \mathrm{pm}$ and in Phenol it is $136 \mathrm{pm}$. The $\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{O}$ bond length in phenol is shorter than that in methanol due to the conjugation of unshared pair of electrons on oxygen with the ring, which imparts double bond character to the $\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{O}$ bond.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
Identify the correct statements from the following.

i) Quartz is a piezoelectric material
ii) All group 14 tetrachlorides except CCl4 are easily hydrolyzed in water.
iii) The C-C bond distance within the layer of graphite is 154pm.
iv) SiO2 is soluble in aqueous HCl solution.
questions.solution:
1) Quartz is hard, crystalline mineral composed of silicon and oxygen. The atoms are linked in a continuous framework of SiO4 silicon-oxygen tetrahedra, with each oxygen being shared between the two tetrahedra. The first piezoelectric material used in electronic devices is the quartz crystal.

2) Group14 tetrachloride except CCl4 are easily hydrolyzed by water, it is because of non-availability of the vacant d-orbitals and steric crowding due to the presence of 4-Cl atoms around C-atom which does not allow the water molecule to approach the antibonding orbitals of  C-Cl bonds.

3) C-C bond distance within the layer of graphite is 141.5  pm

4) SiO2 is insoluble in the aqueous solution of HCl.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
$\mathrm{B}(\mathrm{OH})_3+\mathrm{NaOH} \rightleftharpoons \mathrm{NaBO}_2+\mathrm{Na}\left[\mathrm{B}(\mathrm{OH})_4\right]+\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}$.
How can this reaction is made to proceed in forward direction?
questions.solution:
This reaction is reversible reaction because sodium metaborate, $\mathrm{Na}^{+}\left[\mathrm{B}(\mathrm{OH})_4\right]^{-}$formed by the reaction between $\mathrm{B}(\mathrm{OH})_3$ and $\mathrm{NaOH}$ gets hydrolysed to regenerate $\mathrm{B}(\mathrm{OH})_3$ and $\mathrm{NaOH}$
If, some quantity of polyhydroxy compound like cis-1, 3-diol, catechol, glycerol etc. is added to the reaction mixture. The $\mathrm{B}(\mathrm{OH})_3$ combines with such polyhydroxy compound to give chelated complex compound. Due to complex compound formation, stability increases and due to higher stability of complex, reaction moves in forward direction.
